headline: Two NHL players placed on waivers for Nov. 8
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that two NHL players were placed on waivers for Nov. 8, and says Arvid Soderblom looks to be headed back to the AHL after a tough start to the season. Scott Powers of The Athletic posted that the Blackhawks were expected to place the goalie on waivers that day.

The numbers back up why. Soderblom has a .842 save percentage in five games for CHI so far this season. Goals saved above expected, which compares the goals a goalie allowed with what an average goalie would allow on the same shots, sits at -5.64 over that stretch. Last season he was at -4.68 across 26 games, so he has already given back more than that in a fifth of the games. It's a small sample, but it points the same direction as last year. A never-drafted free agent who arrived after a .922 season at Skellefteå in Sweden, he hasn't yet shown the level that earned him the NHL job. We'd expect CHI to lean on its other goalies while he works on things in the AHL.
